shared_elements: dense field of pictographic signs arranged in rows/columns
justification: Both surfaces are covered with dense grids of pictographic signs, some enclosed in oval/rounded frames, filling registers on a stela-like monument, which is a generic shared trait of logographic inscriptions rather than a specific motif. A shows a distinct figural lunette (paired figures adoring a rayed disc, flanked by name-frames) above many horizontal text lines, whereas B has no figural scene at all and its signs are blocky compound glyphs in paired columns rendered in high relief with quite different internal conventions.
